def priority(f):
    d = f['distance']
    rd = f['return_distance']
    nr = f['nearest_remaining']
    r = f['regret']
    p = f['progress']
    s = f['spread']
    denom = 0.5 + nr
    if denom < 1e-9:
        denom = 1e-9
    return -d + 0.25 * (1 + p) * rd + 0.1 * r + 0.1 * r / denom - 0.05 * s
